thing-type.label: Generic Bluetooth Device
thing-type.description: A generic bluetooth device that supports GATT characteristics

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: The frequency at which readable characteristics refreshed

parameter.name: alwaysConnected
parameter.label: Connect Automatically
parameter.description: If enabled, will automatically connect to the device and reconnect if connection is lost.

parameter.name: connectionSecurity
parameter.label: Connection Security
parameter.description:
LE connection security for this device (honoured by transports that support it, e.g. the Direct-BT adapter).
None: unencrypted connection (default).
Encrypted: request an encrypted link (Just-Works pairing, no PIN). Strict: never falls back to an unencrypted connection.
PIN: encrypted and authenticated link (Passkey Entry) using the configured Passkey. Strict: the connection is refused rather than downgraded if the device cannot pair authenticated.

parameter.name: phy
parameter.label: LE PHY
parameter.description: Preferred LE PHY for the established connection. "coded" (long range) trades bandwidth for roughly 12 dB of extra link budget and suits weak/far devices; "2m" doubles bandwidth at slightly less range. The preference is requested after each connect and silently falls back to 1M when either side does not support it. Only effective on transports that expose PHY control (e.g. Direct-BT).

parameter.name: gattCache
parameter.label: Fast Reconnect
parameter.description:
Remembers the device's capability layout between connections so reconnects skip the slow rediscovery step (seconds faster). Nothing is stored on disk; the memory lasts until openHAB restarts. Only effective on transports that support it (e.g. Direct-BT).
Enabled - verified: re-checks the layout against the device on every reconnect; safe for every device (default).
Enabled - trusted: reuses the remembered layout without checking; fastest, but if the device's firmware is updated it can silently read the wrong values until openHAB restarts. Only for devices whose firmware never changes.
Disabled: full rediscovery on every reconnect (troubleshooting).

parameter.name: passkey
parameter.label: Passkey
parameter.description: The device's fixed 6-digit pairing PIN (0..999999), used when Connection Security is PIN.

channel-type.label: Unknown Bluetooth Characteristic
channel-type.description: The raw value of unknown characteristics are represented with hexadecimal
